notes: Single electron in uniform fields, WarpX 26.09 2D run (algo.particle_pusher, algo.maxwell_solver = none, ParticleExtrema reduced diagnostic every step) against VEL-PIC's push kernels with the same initial half-step push-back. The WarpX inputs and outputs are stored in benchmarks/warpx_compare/data/pushers. In the relativistic E x B case the Boris pusher drifts sideways by 1.34e-04 of the path (its known error, identical in WarpX), whereas Vay and Higuera-Cary keep the particle on a straight line.
